title: Media upload
subtitle: Upload the audio or video file for this project. Uploads resume after network drops and page refreshes.

picker.label: Media file
picker.dropHint: Or drag and drop a file here.
picker.formats: Accepted formats: MP4, QuickTime, Matroska, WAV, MP3, FLAC.
picker.serverNote: File-type checks here are a hint only — the server validates the media and has the final say.

validation.empty: The selected file is empty. Pick a non-empty media file.
validation.network: The connection dropped before the upload started. Reconnect and try again.

controls.reattach: Choose the file again to continue
controls.cancelDescription: Uploaded parts are discarded server-side and the local session is cleared. This cannot be undone.

resumePrompt.title: An upload is waiting to resume
resumePrompt.description: {{done}} of {{total}} parts are already uploaded. Re-attach the same file to continue — completed parts are kept.
resumePrompt.networkDescription: The upload paused itself. Reconnect, then resume — {{done}} of {{total}} parts are already uploaded.

reattachPrompt.title: Re-attach your file to continue
reattachPrompt.description: The page was refreshed, so the file itself is gone but {{done}} of {{total}} uploaded parts are intact. Choose the same file to resume.

fingerprint.restarted: The chosen file differs from the one that started this upload, so a fresh upload was started.

duplicate.title: This exact file is already uploaded
duplicate.description: A completed upload with the same content already exists for this project.

phases.uploaded: Upload complete — waiting for server validation…

rejected.title: Media was rejected
rejected.duplicateTitle: This media is already in the project
rejected.duplicateGuidance: The same content was uploaded before. Use the existing media instead of uploading again.
rejected.unsupportedGuidance: Upload MP4, QuickTime, Matroska, WAV, MP3, or FLAC. Other containers and codecs are rejected.
rejected.corruptGuidance: Re-export the source from your editor and upload the fresh file. If it still fails, try a different export preset.
rejected.expiredGuidance: Sessions last 7 days. Start a new upload with the same file.
rejected.unknownTitle: The server could not accept this media
rejected.unknownGuidance: Report this reference to support and try again with a fresh export.

ready.title: Media is ready
ready.description: Validation and analysis passed. You can start processing from the workspace.

toasts.rejected: Media was rejected. See the guidance below.
